# k3d_job (Resource)

A Kubernetes Job with one container. Jobs are immutable, so any change except `wait` and `timeout` replaces and re-runs it. A failed job is tainted and replaced by the next apply. For volumes or several containers, use `k3d_manifest`. Do not use this for a Helm chart's hook jobs. In a namespace with Istio injection the sidecar keeps the job running forever, so set `pod_annotations = { "sidecar.istio.io/inject" = "false" }`. Import with `<cluster>/<namespace>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k3d_job" "seed" {
  cluster   = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace = k3d_namespace.app.name
  name      = "seed"
  image     = "busybox:1.36"
  command   = ["sh", "-c", "echo seeded"]

  pod_annotations = {
    "sidecar.istio.io/inject" = "false"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Container image with a pinned tag or digest.
- `name` (String) Job name.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on the job.
- `args` (List of String) Container arguments.
- `backoff_limit` (Number) Retries before the job fails. Defaults to 6.
- `cluster` (String) Cluster to manage the object in, usually `k3d_cluster.<name>.id`, so the object is recreated when the cluster is replaced. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `command` (List of String) Container command.
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables.
- `image_pull_secrets` (List of String) Names of pull secrets.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster that is reached directly and not through Docker. Not recorded as a dependency on the cluster's lifetime, so prefer `cluster` for clusters in the same configuration. It is stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted state backend.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the job.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the object. Defaults to `default`.
- `pod_annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on the job's pods.
- `service_account_name` (String) Service account for the pods.
- `timeout` (String) How long to wait. Defaults to `5m`.
- `ttl_seconds_after_finished` (Number) Delete the job this long after it finishes. Terraform keeps it in state afterwards, so it is not re-run. With `wait`, use at least 10 seconds: a job removed before its result is seen is reported as an error, because it may have failed.
- `wait` (Boolean) Wait for the job to finish. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster>/<namespace>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_job.seed demo/app/seed
```
